metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.8 · 2010 · Clash of the Titans
metas.description: Perseus, a demigod and the son of Zeus, battles the minions of Hades and the Underworld in order to stop them from conquering Olympus and Earth.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.7 · 2012 · Wrath of the Titans
metas.description: Perseus braves the treacherous underworld to rescue his father, Zeus, captured by his son, Ares, and brother Hades who unleash the ancient Titans upon the world.
